activities.title: Welcome Back: Look Closer
activities.summary: Students move from one full garment view to close-up detail noticing by answering four quick recognition questions about visible design details.

en.title: Welcome Back: Look Closer
en.summary: Look at the full look and the close-up crops. Choose the best answer for each quick question.
en.instructions: Look at the full garment or sketch and the three close-up crops together. Use the visible clues to answer four short questions about the detail names and locations.
success_criteria: I can notice visible design details.
I can connect one close-up crop to the full look.
I can answer using visible clues only.
sentence_frames: I can see ___ in the close-up.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: observe mais de perto
pt.summary: Observe o look completo e os close-ups. Escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta rapida.
pt.instructions: Observe juntos a roupa ou o sketch completo e os tres close-ups. Use apenas as pistas visiveis para responder a quatro perguntas curtas sobre nomes e localizacao de detalhes.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber detalhes de design visiveis.
Eu consigo ligar um close-up ao look completo.
Eu consigo responder usando apenas pistas visiveis.
sentence_frames: I can see ___ in the close-up.

input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta rapida sobre detalhes.

options_en: Look at the full garment and the details.

activities.title: Design Detail Vocabulary
activities.summary: Students match a keyed close-up board to core English design-detail words, then use two short Portuguese support checks without changing the main matching output.

en.title: Design Detail Vocabulary

activities.title: Find the Details: Functional or Decorative?
activities.summary: Students identify visible point-labeled details on one garment and then complete short secondary checks about whether selected details are functional, decorative, or both.

en.title: Find the Details: Functional or Decorative?
en.summary: Match the point labels to the correct details. Then choose the role for three details.
en.instructions: Look at the garment with point labels A to H. Match each point to the correct detail. After that, answer the short role questions: functional, decorative, or both.
success_criteria: I can identify visible details from point labels.
I can connect a detail to its role.
I can keep matching as my main task.

pt.title: Encontre os detalhes: funcional ou decorativo?
pt.summary: Relacione os pontos com os detalhes corretos. Depois escolha a funcao de tres detalhes.
pt.instructions: Observe a roupa com os pontos A a H. Relacione cada ponto com o detalhe correto. Depois responda as perguntas curtas sobre funcao: funcional, decorativo ou ambos.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar detalhes visiveis a partir de pontos marcados.
Eu consigo ligar um detalhe a sua funcao.
Eu consigo manter a relacao como minha tarefa principal.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the point labels A to H visible and stable. Matching is the main saved output; the role questions are short secondary checks only.
materials: Week 11 scavenger garment with point labels A to H

Mixing details from two different images.
Forgetting the article in a zipper or the plural in there are patch pockets.
Using decorative when the reason is practical use.

challenge: Ask stronger learners to use both adds and makes across different lines.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render the reusable gallery with stable image A to image D labels and require the student to choose one key before writing. Save the selected image key and each structured line separately. Show the selected image key and gallery image to the teacher during review. Include the checklist, common-error prompts, and return-for-revision support for one specific line or one missing required element. Do not use a paragraph box and do not use any word-count requirement.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Clear Detail Captions
